_comment: The Grade 1 Global Perspectives standalone lesson build, described for ../../mathematics/lesson-app-tools and built by ../lesson-kit. Order here IS the lesson number. Eight lessons organised by the six skills of Cambridge Primary Global Perspectives 0838 Stage 1 (18 objectives), each anchored on one topic a five-year-old can talk about, NOT by the four units of the Word-pack course under global-perspectives/grade-1/data, so progress is written under l01..l08 - see THE UNIT PROBLEM in wire-progress.py. objectiveFloors are recorded at the measured value after each build and may rise, not fall.
subject: global-perspectives
hubStrands: Asking questions about a topic; talking about what a picture or a book tells us; asking classmates to find things out; and recording what we found in a pictogram or a simple chart.
Saying what we already know about a topic; talking about what a pictogram shows; thinking about what happens to us because of what we do; and choosing an action that could fix a problem.
Choosing the source that would help us find out about a topic, and saying why; and saying what we think about a topic.
Saying what we did to help the team, and what a friend did; saying what we learned in an activity; and saying what we liked.
Sharing what we have with a partner so that both of us can finish; and working kindly and positively with others.
Answering a question with the information that was asked for; and listening to others, then asking them a simple question about what they said.
